reading: This is a magazine-cover hero: a full-height near-black panel on the right side of the page, with an italic 'Contrast' logo top-left and a vertical 'A MAGAZINE ABOUT OPPOSITES' tagline running down the far-left edge, both on the white background. A blue-to-pink gradient rectangle overlaps the upper-left corner of the dark panel, sitting on top of it. A large two-line italic headline 'Light keeps the dark honest' stretches across both the white page and the dark panel with inverting text colour, followed by a two-line body paragraph on white, and a small underlined link 'Read the issue →' sits near the bottom-right on the dark panel. Page-wide defaults are white background, Georgia type, near-black text.
